seoTitle: Request a Property Assessment | Contact Sivan Management, Chania
seoDescription: Tell us about your property in Crete. Request an assessment and a tailored management proposal from Sivan Management in Chania.
title: Request a property assessment.
lead: Four short steps. We reply personally, usually within one business day.
directBody: Call, WhatsApp or email us, or visit our office in central Chania.

form.unitsHint: For a single villa or apartment, enter 1.
form.goals: What would you like to achieve? (optional)
form.goalsPlaceholder: For example: start renting next season, reduce my involvement, improve results…
form.name: Full name
form.consent: I agree that Sivan Management may process my details to respond to this request, as described in the Privacy Policy.
form.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
form.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again, or contact us directly by email or phone.
form.successTitle: Thank you, we have received your request.
form.successBody: We will review the details and contact you shortly. A confirmation has been noted in our system.
form.privacyNotice: Providing your details is voluntary. We use them only to answer your request and prepare a proposal; they are e-mailed to our team and stored on our server in Israel, and are not shared for marketing. You can ask to see, correct or delete them at any time. Details in our Privacy Policy.

recaptcha.text: When you click Send, Google reCAPTCHA checks that you are not a robot (Google may set a cookie for this). The Google {privacy} and {terms} apply.

thanks.title: Thank you.
thanks.body: Your request has reached us. A member of our team will contact you personally, usually within one business day.
thanks.next: While you wait, read our guides for property owners.
